youtube.name: Dream Jobs ✨ AI daydreams
youtube.description:
Welcome to Dream Jobs ✨

Every Short is a magical little job from a dreamy life: fishing for fallen stars, bottling sunlight honey, sewing gowns from butterflies, drying rainbows on a washing line.

All videos are made with AI (images, motion and music) and edited by hand. No real people appear.

New dream every day. Tell me in the comments which dream job you want to see next.
